name: Saltare
author: Jack Thorne
description: Unread channels, mentions and today's work from your Saltare workspace, plus a capture field that sends to a channel, files a task, starts a document or asks an agent. Reads a state file published by the sal CLI, which holds the session — this plugin stores no credentials and makes no network requests.

barWidget.description: Unread, mentions, and today's work — read from the sal watch state file.

schema.label: Show with nothing waiting
schema.description: Off hides the widget until something is unread, mentioning you, overdue or due today.

schema.label: Treat the state as stale after (seconds)
schema.description: 0 follows the daemon's own heartbeat — three missed beats, the same rule sal status uses.
